verdict.rationale: Elastic publishes an official MCP server for Elasticsearch (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch), so agents can reach search indexes through an MCP tool surface. The pack also mentions official skills that teach AI coding agents to work with the Elastic stack. However, nothing documents which tools the server exposes, so query, analytics and index operations as tools are not evidenced. missing for 10: documentation of the MCP server's tool set covering query, aggregations/analytics and index-management operations, maturity or support status of the server, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
